newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay to issue $425 million in 36-year bonds.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay to issue $425 million in 36-year bonds.

text.p: Paraguay's government is planning to issue $425 million of 36-year bonds to finance all of its internal debt, economy ministry sources said Monday.
Paraguay's internal debt is made up of credits from the central bank for public firms and for government spending over the years.
The date of the issue depends on Congress' approval and government spokesmen said they expected that go ahead before the end of November.

The source said the bonds will be traded on the Stock Exchange and be sold directly to financial market operators, in order to supplement the current monetary regulation bills used as instruments to control the amount of money in circulation.
